describes: Whose job it is is checked against THIS household's roster, not merely against the shape of an id. `membership.id` is unique across the table rather than per household, so a real id from somebody else's household satisfies the foreign key and would store an item assigned to a stranger — one that every client then renders as assigned to nobody, because none of them can resolve a name outside their own roster. The refusal does not say which kind of wrong id it was; that would confirm one exists.

body.error: no member of this household has the id fx-member-nobody
